title: Therapeutic potential of betaine and its derivatives in cancer treatment: a comprehensive review

This review article highlights the role of betaine and its derivatives in the prevention of different types of cancers, their inhibitory activities against tumorigenesis, metastasis and angiogenesis and their mechanism of action thereof.
